lang-missing.summary: The html element must declare a lang attribute so assistive tech uses the right pronunciation/voice.

lang-invalid.summary: The html lang attribute must be a valid, assigned language tag.

heading-order.summary: Heading levels must not skip — they convey document structure to screen reader users.

label-pairing.summary: Form controls must have a programmatically associated label (for/id, nesting, or aria-label/aria-labelledby).

landmark-main.summary: The page must expose a main landmark (<main> or role="main") so assistive tech users can jump to content.

skip-link.summary: Pages with repeated navigation need a mechanism (e.g. a skip link) to bypass it.

img-alt.summary: Images require alternative text (alt="" for decorative images).
